title: Divide by Constant and Round
text: Divide input by a constant and round to integer, 1 input, 1 output, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding method to use; {Denominator} sets the divisor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Dividend scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Result of division and round operation scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Rounding Method
params.values: Rounding method to use Floor (default) | Ceiling | Nearest | Zero | Convergent
